_readme: Generic per-user notification preference (chapter 04, section 3.2). One row per user, written only for the caller by a preferences flow. If your app already has a per-user preferences model, add the channel field there instead of creating this one.
name: UserNotificationPreference

fields.name: channel
fields.note: teams | email | both | empty (= defaultChannel in teamsNotificationSettings)

fields.name: mutedEvents
fields.note: optional list of event names the user does not want

fields.name: timeZone
fields.note: IANA zone for times on cards and quiet hours, e.g. America/New_York
